authority: One borrowed Resource array and optional WideCost array per read window; lifetime and immutability are caller requirements.
overlay: Only remote boundary records are copied into a captured shared_ptr<const RRStateOverlay>; current authoritative net owner is retained.
synchronization: Every worker future joins before the first authoritative commit or ordered replay. ResourceReader journals all observed versions, including cost reads and discarded candidates.
shadow_storage: For N nodes, B boundary nodes and D dies: (D+1)*B BoundaryShadow records; O(N) owner/boundary metadata remains. Boundary ID-to-index lookup is separate.
invariants: No new net owner can be fabricated by an overlay.
Boundary summaries reject same-version differing payloads and drop older versions.
Previously captured overlays remain unchanged after later summary publication.
Interior resource and cost access borrows authoritative array addresses.
excluded: No elimination of per-worker static RRBackend topology/incoming-index copies.
No hardware bandwidth, latency or board speedup claim.
